text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You mean birthdays rock, yeah? I think
I'm
starting to get the hang of your
"marvelous"
usage...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Tonight, we're having a sleepover party
in
Marvey's room!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I know you're saying that it's gonna be
super
exciting, but don't forget that
your room is also
my room.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I haven't heard anything about a
sleepover party.
Are you guys gonna
make a racket the entire
night?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? So we can't have a sleepover?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... D-don't give me those puppy
eyes... All
right, fine, you can have your
sleepover!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, I know you love me... And I'm
grateful
for it.
